product.name: Monoprice Blackbird H.265 Video Receiver/Decoder over IP with HDMI Receiver Only
product.description: The Blackbird™ PRO H.265 HDMI® over IP Kit allows you to distribute an HDMI video signal to distances up to 492 feet (150 meters) over a single Cat5e/6 Ethernet cable. In addition to a normal connection between the Encoder/Transmitter and Decoder/Receiver, the Encoder can be connected directly to a computer and the signal can be decoded using the VLC® free, open‑source media player. It can also connect to one or more Decoders/Receivers through an Ethernet switch, thereby allowing distribution to multiple displays. it supports the H.264 and H.265 codecs and video resolutions up to 1900x1200@60Hz with the YCbCr 4:4:4 color space.This is the Decoder/Receiver only. Click here for the complete kit (43624).Features: Compliant with the HDMI® 1.4b and HDCP™ 1.4 specificationsSupports 10.2 Gbps bandwidthSupports video resolutions up to 1900x1200@60Hz YCbCr 4:4:4Supports the H.264 and H.265 codecsTransmits to distances up to 492 feet (150 meters) over a single Cat5e/6 Ethernet cableSupports broadband IR extensionSupport Files: User's Manual (Apr 26, 2023)Monoprice™, Blackbird™, the Blackbird logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
